df = pd.read_csv('messages_train.csv')

X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test = train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, export_text
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
df = pd.read_csv('messages_train.csv')
features = ['text_len','has_link','has_discount','has_urgent']
X,y = df[features],df['label']
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test = train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train,y_train)
new = pd.read_csv('messages_new_examples.csv')
for depth in [1,3]:
    current = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=depth,random_state=42).fit(X_train,y_train)

Изменился второй новый прогноз: unclear→normal. Остальные три сохранились. Accuracy выросла 0.625→0.875 на этом test.

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
df = pd.read_csv('iris_real_dataset.csv')
print('До очистки:',df.shape,'пропусков:',int(df.isna().sum().sum()))
df = df.dropna()
features = ['sepal_length_cm','sepal_width_cm','petal_length_cm','petal_width_cm']
X,y = df[features],df['species']
train_ids,test_ids = train_test_split(df.index,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=42)
model.fit(X.loc[train_ids],y.loc[train_ids])
predictions = model.predict(X.loc[test_ids])
result = X.loc[test_ids].copy()
result['true_species'] = y.loc[test_ids]
result['predicted_species'] = predictions
print(df.head().to_string(index=False))
print(df.dtypes.to_string())
print('Train/test:',len(train_ids),len(test_ids))
print(result.head(10).to_string(index=False))
print('Accuracy:',round(accuracy_score(y.loc[test_ids],predictions),4))

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

features = ['sepal_length_cm','sepal_width_cm','petal_length_cm','petal_width_cm']

train_ids,test_ids = train_test_split(df.index,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=42)
model.fit(X.loc[train_ids],y.loc[train_ids])
predictions = model.predict(X.loc[test_ids])
result = X.loc[test_ids].copy()
result['true_species'] = y.loc[test_ids]
result['predicted_species'] = predictions
for columns in [features,['petal_length_cm','petal_width_cm']]:
    current = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=42).fit(df.loc[train_ids,columns],y.loc[train_ids])
    pred = current.predict(df.loc[test_ids,columns])
    print(columns,'accuracy=',round(accuracy_score(y.loc[test_ids],pred),4))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix,accuracy_score,ConfusionMatrixDisplay
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv('iris_confusion_dataset.csv')
X,y = df.drop(columns='species'),df['species']
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test = train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.3,random_state=42,stratify=y)
labels = ['setosa','versicolor','virginica']
for depth in [2,3]:
    model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=depth,random_state=42).fit(X_train,y_train)
    predicted = model.predict(X_test)
    matrix = confusion_matrix(y_test,predicted,labels=labels)
    print('Глубина',depth,'accuracy=',round(accuracy_score(y_test,predicted),4),'ошибок=',int(matrix.sum()-np.trace(matrix)))
    print(matrix)
